verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to its full API reference, published as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec at openpm.ai/packages/reflect/openapi.json. The spec covers graphs, links, daily-notes, notes and users/me with OAuth2 scopes. However, it is hosted on a third-party registry rather than first-party, standard first-party paths return 404, and the spec is early (v0.1.0) with no documented versioning. missing for 10: first-party-hosted or discoverable spec path, spec versioning/deprecation policy, independent hands-on corroboration of the spec's accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Reflect's full API reference is published as an OpenAPI package on openpm, linked from the vendor docs
